result.title: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
result.summary: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

AI.brief_summary: 针对外科机器人模仿学习示范稀缺的问题，FlowScope 用 1149 台手术的立体视频无监督预训练 ACT 主干，任务是预测由现成深度与光流模型算出的场景流（场景点的度量 3D 运动），预训练后丢弃流预测头，部署时仍是标准 ACT、无额外推理开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文本身不涉及 LVR 或 VLM 推理，但其「预测度量 3D 运动」这一视觉预训练目标与 2D 轨迹、单深度、无尺度流的消融对比，以及深度探针分析，可能为 LVR 中内部状态如何保留任务必需的几何信息提供可供核查的训练侧线索。
